_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Brothers Return#001.src: Hey! Don't put that down there
Brothers Return#001.speaker: Sayleros

Brothers Return#002.src: Oh, hello there, adventurer! I was just looking for someone like you! My name is Sayleros. I lived in {p} my whole life, but recently decided to move to {p}.
Brothers Return#002.dst: 오, 안녕, 모험가! 마침 너 같은 사람을 찾고 있었어! 난 Sayleros야. 평생 {p}에 살았는데, 얼마 전 {p}(으)로 이사하기로 했지.
Brothers Return#002.speaker: Sayleros

Brothers Return#003.src: You see, my older brother just passed. I would have taken care of it, if only I weren't so busy with the move!
Brothers Return#003.dst: 그게, 우리 큰형이 막 세상을 떠났어. 이사로 바쁘지만 않았어도 내가 처리했을 텐데!
Brothers Return#003.speaker: Sayleros

Brothers Return#004.src: I had to leave it all to my younger brother, Drucksh. He's still in {p}, but well, he's not the most reliable...
Brothers Return#004.dst: 그래서 동생 Drucksh한테 다 맡겨야 했지. 아직 {p}에 있는데, 음, 믿음직한 녀석은 아니라서...
Brothers Return#004.speaker: Sayleros

Brothers Return#005.src: My older brother had amassed quite some wealth before he passed. He should have left us part of it in his will, only I don't exactly trust Drucksh to handle it...
Brothers Return#005.dst: 큰형이 죽기 전에 재산을 꽤 모았거든. 유언장에 우리 몫을 남겼을 텐데, Drucksh한테 맡기기는 영 불안해서...
Brothers Return#005.speaker: Sayleros

Brothers Return#006.src: If you could go to {p} and see if Drucksh has the will, I would forever be in your debt, pal.
Brothers Return#006.dst: {p}에 가서 Drucksh가 유언장을 갖고 있는지 봐 준다면 평생 은혜 갚을게, 친구.
Brothers Return#006.speaker: Sayleros

Brothers Return#007.src: Drucksh shouldn't be hard to find, he usually spends his time in the bar in {p}. Just follow this road out of {p} to get there.
Brothers Return#007.dst: Drucksh는 찾기 쉬울 거야, 보통 {p} 술집에 있거든. 이 길을 따라 {p}을(를) 나가면 돼.
Brothers Return#007.speaker: Sayleros

Brothers Return#008.src: Find Drucksh at the bar in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Brothers Return#009.src: Thanks again for doing this, pal. Just follow this road out of {p} to get to {p}, Drucksh's usually at the bar there.
Brothers Return#009.dst: 다시 한번 고마워, 친구. 이 길 따라 {p}을(를) 나가면 {p}이야. Drucksh는 보통 거기 술집에 있어.
Brothers Return#009.speaker: Sayleros

Brothers Return#012.src: Aauuughh... s-something... mmmmgh... to... drink... aaaughh...
Brothers Return#012.dst: 아아으으... 뭐, 뭐라도... 으으음... 마실... 거... 아아으...
Brothers Return#012.speaker: Drucksh

Brothers Return#013.src: Find a way to make Drucksh tell you about the will.
Brothers Return#013.dst: Drucksh가 유언장에 대해 말하게 할 방법을 찾으세요.

Brothers Return#014.src: Aauuughh... s-something... mmmmgh... to... drink... aaaughh...
Brothers Return#014.dst: 아아으으... 뭐, 뭐라도... 으으음... 마실... 거... 아아으...
Brothers Return#014.speaker: Drucksh

Brothers Return#016.src: Anythin' is possible. If ya have [{~} Emeralds] to spare, that is.
Brothers Return#016.dst: 뭐든 가능하지. [{~} Emeralds]를 쓸 여유만 있다면 말이야.
Brothers Return#016.speaker: Barkeep

Brothers Return#017.src: One {p} Whiskey, shipwrecked against the rocks, comin' right up.
Brothers Return#017.dst: {p} 위스키 한 잔, 바위에 난파시켜서, 바로 나간다.
Brothers Return#017.speaker: Barkeep

Brothers Return#018.src: Hey, Drucksh. Hey, can you hear me? Hey!
Brothers Return#018.speaker: Barkeep

Brothers Return#020.src: This nice fella got ya a drink. A {p} Whiskey, yer favourite.
Brothers Return#020.dst: 이 친절한 양반이 한잔 사 줬어. {p} 위스키, 네가 제일 좋아하는 거.
Brothers Return#020.speaker: Barkeep

Brothers Return#022.src: Hey! They paid for yer drink, ya know. Ya could at least try to be courteous.
Brothers Return#022.dst: 야! 네 술값을 내 줬잖아. 최소한 예의는 좀 차려.
Brothers Return#022.speaker: Barkeep

Brothers Return#023.src: Oh, s-shut up. I c-can pay for my own drinks!
Brothers Return#023.dst: 아, 닥, 닥쳐. 내 술값은 내, 내가 낼 수 있어!
Brothers Return#023.speaker: Drucksh

Brothers Return#024.src: Well, call me if ya need anythin' else.
Brothers Return#024.speaker: Barkeep

Brothers Return#029.src: Yeah, there ain't no will, pal. After brother died, those Bovemists came and picked 'im up.
Brothers Return#029.dst: 그래, 유언장 같은 건 없어, 친구. 형이 죽고 나서 그 Bovemist들이 와서 형을 데려갔지.
Brothers Return#029.speaker: Drucksh

Brothers Return#030.src: Gave 'im a proper funeral and everything. Shame my dear, oh so dear brother couldn't attend. What kind of person can't be there for their own brother's funeral, y'know?
Brothers Return#030.dst: 장례식도 제대로 치러 줬어. 아쉽게도 사랑하는, 아아 사랑하는 우리 형은 못 왔지. 자기 형 장례식에도 못 오는 인간이 어딨냐고, 응?
Brothers Return#030.speaker: Drucksh

Brothers Return#031.src: Well, I couldn't be there either, bein' here and all, but that's besides the point...
Brothers Return#031.dst: 뭐, 나도 여기 있느라 못 갔지만, 그건 중요한 게 아니고...
Brothers Return#031.speaker: Drucksh

Brothers Return#032.src: Anyway, the Bishop gave me a bit of money for my troubles and sent me on my merry way. Then, I ended up here, and haven't left since!
Brothers Return#032.dst: 아무튼, 주교가 수고비로 돈을 좀 주고 날 기분 좋게 보내 줬어. 그러다 여기로 흘러와서 그 뒤로 안 나갔지!
Brothers Return#032.speaker: Drucksh

Brothers Return#033.src: So, as I already told you... There ain't no will, pal! Forget it.
Brothers Return#033.dst: 그러니까, 이미 말했잖아... 유언장 같은 건 없다고, 친구! 잊어버려.
Brothers Return#033.speaker: Drucksh

Brothers Return#034.src: W-what? Sayleros told you about a will, a-and about money too, t-that brother left us?
Brothers Return#034.dst: 뭐, 뭐라고? Sayleros가 유언장 얘기를 했다고? 그, 그리고 형이 우리한테 남, 남긴 돈 얘기도?
Brothers Return#034.speaker: Drucksh

Brothers Return#035.src: So then why did the Bishop...
Brothers Return#035.speaker: Drucksh

Brothers Return#037.src: S-stop! Hold your horses... That would mean...
Brothers Return#037.dst: 자, 잠깐! 진정해 봐... 그 말은 곧...
Brothers Return#037.speaker: Drucksh

Brothers Return#038.src: Hey, soldier! We're leaving, right now! W-we're gonna find that will!
Brothers Return#038.dst: 어이, 군인! 당장 출발이다! 우, 우리가 그 유언장을 찾을 거야!
Brothers Return#038.speaker: Drucksh

Brothers Return#039.src: Speak to the Bishop Kaideus in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Brothers Return#040.src: Yes, yes. A little more to the right! Hurry!
Brothers Return#040.dst: 그래, 그래. 오른쪽으로 조금 더! 서두르게!
Brothers Return#040.speaker: Bishop Kaideus

Brothers Return#041.src: Hey! Priest man, guy, whatever! Where's my brother!
Brothers Return#041.dst: 어이! 사제 양반, 거기, 아무튼! 우리 형 어딨어!
Brothers Return#041.speaker: Drucksh

Brothers Return#042.src: Oh, it's you. For your information, the proper term of address is your excellency.
Brothers Return#042.speaker: Bishop Kaideus

Brothers Return#043.src: You may have forgotten already, but I must inform you that your brother is indeed dead.
Brothers Return#043.dst: 벌써 잊었을지 모르나, 자네 형은 정말로 죽었음을 알려 주지.
Brothers Return#043.speaker: Bishop Kaideus

Brothers Return#044.src: Y-yes, I know all that, y-your priestliness. But where's my brother? I want to see 'im.
Brothers Return#044.dst: 아, 알아, 다 안다고, 사, 사제 나리. 근데 우리 형 어딨어? 형을 봐야겠어.
Brothers Return#044.speaker: Drucksh

Brothers Return#045.src: You! Talk some sense into your, um, friend here. We buried his brother in the crypt here some time ago.
Brothers Return#045.dst: 자네! 자네, 음, 친구 좀 타이르게. 그의 형은 얼마 전 이곳 지하 묘지에 묻었네.
Brothers Return#045.speaker: Bishop Kaideus

Brothers Return#046.src: Now, please leave this peaceful house of worship, you're causing a ruckus. I have some quite important business to attend to, you see.
Brothers Return#046.dst: 자, 이 평화로운 예배당에서 나가 주게. 소란을 피우고 있지 않나. 나는 꽤 중요한 일을 처리해야 한단 말일세.
Brothers Return#046.speaker: Bishop Kaideus

Brothers Return#047.src: Hey! I'm not leaving without my brother! No way, pal!
Brothers Return#047.dst: 야! 형 없이는 안 나가! 절대 안 돼, 친구!
Brothers Return#047.speaker: Drucksh

Brothers Return#048.src: As I already told you, your brother is dead and buried. It's not like
Brothers Return#048.dst: 이미 말했듯, 자네 형은 죽어서 묻혔네. 그러니까
Brothers Return#048.speaker: Bishop Kaideus

Brothers Return#050.src: Holy Bovine! It's even worse than I feared!
Brothers Return#050.dst: 신성한 소여! 걱정했던 것보다 더 심하군!
Brothers Return#050.speaker: Bishop Kaideus

Brothers Return#051.src: You, soldier! You better not stick your nose in this! It's not for the likes of you to mess with the affairs of the church!
Brothers Return#051.dst: 자네, 군인! 이 일에 코 들이밀지 말게! 자네 같은 자가 교회 일에 끼어들 자격은 없네!
Brothers Return#051.speaker: Bishop Kaideus

Brothers Return#052.src: Now's our chance, pal! Go find my brother in the crypts! I-I'll stay behind, guarding the rear!
Brothers Return#052.dst: 지금이 기회야, 친구! 지하 묘지에서 형을 찾아 줘! 나, 난 뒤에 남아서 후방을 지킬게!
Brothers Return#052.speaker: Drucksh

Brothers Return#053.src: Enter the crypt at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] and find Sayleros' Brother.
Brothers Return#053.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 지하 묘지에 들어가 Sayleros의 형을 찾으세요.

Brothers Return#054.src: Now's our chance, pal! Go find my brother in the crypts! I-I'll stay behind, guarding the rear!
Brothers Return#054.dst: 지금이 기회야, 친구! 지하 묘지에서 형을 찾아 줘! 나, 난 뒤에 남아서 후방을 지킬게!
Brothers Return#054.speaker: Drucksh

Brothers Return#055.src: You better not stick your nose in this, soldier! It's not for the likes of you to mess with the affairs of the church!
Brothers Return#055.dst: 이 일에 코 들이밀지 말게, 군인! 자네 같은 자가 교회 일에 끼어들 자격은 없네!
Brothers Return#055.speaker: Bishop Kaideus

Brothers Return#056.src: Don't ask me about anything! I just work here!
Brothers Return#056.dst: 나한테 아무것도 묻지 마! 난 여기서 일만 해!
Brothers Return#056.speaker: Worker

Brothers Return#059.src: Open the door at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] using the Crypt Basement Key.

Brothers Return#061.src: Open the door at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] using the Sealed Crypt Key.

Brothers Return#065.src: Bring back Sayleros' brother's will to [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Brothers Return#066.src: As I've already told you a thousand times, I don't know what will you're talking about! Besides, I don't have the time for this!
Brothers Return#066.dst: 천 번은 말했지만, 무슨 유언장 얘기인지 모르네! 게다가 이럴 시간도 없단 말일세!
Brothers Return#066.speaker: Bishop Kaideus

Brothers Return#068.src: I certainly hope you didn't use the usual methods of your sort...
Brothers Return#068.dst: 자네 같은 부류가 늘 쓰는 방식은 안 썼기를 진심으로 바라네...
Brothers Return#068.speaker: Bishop Kaideus

Brothers Return#069.src: ... B-brother! What are y-you doing here?
Brothers Return#069.dst: ... 혀, 형! 여기서 뭐, 뭐 해?
Brothers Return#069.speaker: Drucksh

Brothers Return#070.src: Drucksh! Likewise, what are you doing here?
Brothers Return#070.dst: Drucksh! 나도 묻자, 넌 여기서 뭐 해?
Brothers Return#070.speaker: Sayleros

Brothers Return#071.src: W-well... I-I thought I'd take responsibility for our family for once...
Brothers Return#071.dst: 그, 그게... 이, 이번만큼은 내가 집안 일을 책임져 볼까 해서...
Brothers Return#071.speaker: Drucksh

Brothers Return#072.src: I thought I wouldn't live to see the day! Here I was, worried Drucksh wouldn't cooperate, but it seems like the two of you've got it all under control after all.
Brothers Return#072.dst: 살아서 이런 날을 볼 줄이야! Drucksh가 협조 안 할까 봐 걱정했는데, 결국 너희 둘이 다 잘 처리했나 보네.
Brothers Return#072.speaker: Sayleros

Brothers Return#073.src: Under control!? This... This... renegade stormed into the crypts and k-k-killed your brother!
Brothers Return#073.dst: 잘 처리해!? 이... 이... 배교자가 묘지에 쳐들어가서 자네 형을 주, 주, 죽였단 말일세!
Brothers Return#073.speaker: Bishop Kaideus

Brothers Return#074.src: He's our brother, your priestliness! Let us w-worry about 'im and you can worry about your great cow in the sky, or whatever it is.
Brothers Return#074.dst: 우리 형이라고, 사제 나리! 형 걱정은 우리가 할 테니, 넌 하늘에 계신 위대한 소인지 뭔지나 걱정해.
Brothers Return#074.speaker: Drucksh

Brothers Return#075.src: That's right, your priestliness! Here, I'll take the will.
Brothers Return#075.dst: 맞아요, 사제 나리! 자, 유언장은 제가 받죠.
Brothers Return#075.speaker: Sayleros

Brothers Return#076.src: Hey, brother, why don't we head to the ol' watering hole. For old brother's sake.
Brothers Return#076.dst: 야, 동생아, 그 단골 술집에 가자. 큰형을 위해서.
Brothers Return#076.speaker: Sayleros

Brothers Return#077.src: Well, i-if it's for his sake, then I c-can hardly refuse, can I?
Brothers Return#077.dst: 뭐, 혀, 형을 위해서라면, 거, 거절할 수가 없지, 안 그래?
Brothers Return#077.speaker: Drucksh

Brothers Return#078.src: Please, take this as proof of my gratitude, pal. You really helped us out, in more ways than one.
Brothers Return#078.dst: 고맙다는 증표로 이걸 받아 줘, 친구. 여러모로 정말 큰 도움이 됐어.
Brothers Return#078.speaker: Sayleros

Brothers Return#079.src: Hey soldier! That's quite the gear you're lugging around. Anything I can do for you?
Brothers Return#079.dst: 이봐요, 군인! 대단한 장비를 끌고 다니네요. 뭐 도와드릴까요?
Brothers Return#079.speaker: Alfe

Brothers Return#080.src: Oh, really? I don't think I've seen you before, but I'm not so good with faces, especially armoured ones! I'm new to Wynn, just came through on the caravan. The name's Alfe, and yours?
Brothers Return#080.dst: 오, 정말요? 처음 보는 얼굴 같은데, 전 얼굴을 잘 못 알아봐서요. 갑옷 쓴 얼굴은 더더욱! Wynn엔 처음이고 마차 행렬로 막 왔어요. 전 Alfe예요. 당신은요?
Brothers Return#080.speaker: Alfe

Brothers Return#081.src: {u}, huh? I think I've heard of you somewhere... Laen was regaling stories at the {p} bar, you helped them find some old book, yeah? And I think the Bishop mentioned...
Brothers Return#081.dst: {u}, 그래요? 어디서 들어 본 것 같은데... Laen이 {p} 술집에서 얘기하던데, 오래된 책 찾는 걸 도와줬다죠? 그리고 주교님도 언급하신 것 같은데...
Brothers Return#081.speaker: Alfe

Brothers Return#082.src: You! Back again to cause more mayhem, are we?
Brothers Return#082.speaker: Bishop Kaideus

Brothers Return#083.src: No need to be so hostile, your excellency! We were just discussing our time here in Wynn. {u} here even helped Laen find an old book of theirs, did you know that?
Brothers Return#083.dst: 그렇게 적대하실 필요 없어요, 예하! Wynn에서 보낸 시간 얘기하던 중이었어요. 이 {u} 씨는 Laen의 오래된 책 찾는 것도 도왔대요, 아세요?
Brothers Return#083.speaker: Alfe

Brothers Return#084.src: Hm... Well, you certainly are not, my young apprentice. That much is true...
Brothers Return#084.dst: 흠... 그래, 내 젊은 견습생, 자네는 확실히 아니지. 그건 사실이네...
Brothers Return#084.speaker: Bishop Kaideus

Brothers Return#085.src: Right, {u}! We could really use your help here, isn't that right Kaideus?
Brothers Return#085.dst: 맞다, {u} 씨! 여기 도움이 정말 필요해요, 그렇죠 Kaideus?
Brothers Return#085.speaker: Alfe

Brothers Return#086.src: Another pair of hands on the task wouldn't hurt, you are right about that...
Brothers Return#086.dst: 일손이 하나 더 있어 나쁠 건 없지, 그 말은 맞네...
Brothers Return#086.speaker: Bishop Kaideus

Brothers Return#087.src: Fine! You may inspect the texts, but only if you are very, very careful.
Brothers Return#087.dst: 좋네! 문헌을 살펴봐도 되네. 단, 아주, 아주 조심한다면.
Brothers Return#087.speaker: Bishop Kaideus

Brothers Return#088.src: Well, you see {u}! I've been in {p} for the past little while helping to protect the city. But after Kaideus here stumbled across a shelf of old records I came here to help sort and clean them.
Brothers Return#088.dst: 그게요, {u} 씨! 전 한동안 {p}에서 도시 방어를 돕고 있었어요. 그런데 여기 Kaideus 님이 오래된 기록이 가득한 서가를 우연히 발견해서, 정리하고 손질하러 왔죠.
Brothers Return#088.speaker: Alfe

Brothers Return#089.src: They're positively ancient! It's all nonsense to me, but Laen says they must be over a thousand years old!
Brothers Return#089.dst: 정말 까마득히 오래됐어요! 전 봐도 모르겠지만, Laen 말로는 천 년도 넘었대요!
Brothers Return#089.speaker: Alfe

Brothers Return#090.src: You recruits are much to excitable, but she is right. Having dedicated my life to this cathedral, I have not been afforded the opportunity to see much of the world beyond these plains.
Brothers Return#090.dst: 자네 신참들은 너무 쉽게 흥분하지만, 그녀 말이 맞네. 평생 이 대성당에 몸 바치느라 이 평원 너머 세상을 볼 기회가 없었지.
Brothers Return#090.speaker: Bishop Kaideus

Brothers Return#091.src: So, {u}, why don't you take a look? You've traveled quite a bit, perhaps even to the lands described within. I may not like your methods, but perhaps, just this once, they may prove useful.
Brothers Return#091.dst: 그러니, {u}, 한번 보지 않겠나? 자네는 꽤 돌아다녔으니, 여기 적힌 땅에도 가 봤을지 모르지. 자네 방식은 마음에 안 들지만, 이번만큼은 쓸모 있을지도 모르겠군.
Brothers Return#091.speaker: Bishop Kaideus

Brothers Return#092.src: Well then, what would you like to read?
Brothers Return#092.speaker: Alfe
